name: QTT Tenant
description: The billable organization — the generic SaaS customer. Deliberately product-blind: no student/course/employee/payroll fields belong here. See the QTT SaaS Platform architecture document, section 4.

fields.label: Legal Name
fields.description: Optional — the registered business name, if different from the display name.

fields.label: Slug
fields.description: URL-safe identifier. Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens only — enforced in validate().

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Lifecycle field. suspended/cancelled/archived all lock out every member — see the hardening review section 22 for the exact distinctions.

fields.label: Owner User
fields.description: The user who created this tenant — the bootstrap Tenant Owner. Set once at creation, not intended to be reassigned casually (ownership transfer is a deliberate, auditable action, not a plain field edit).

fields.label: Trial Ends On
fields.description: Null once the tenant converts to a paid subscription on any product.

fields.label: Razorpay Customer ID
fields.description: SaaS lifecycle Phase C. NOT set by qtt_platform.billing pre-creating a Razorpay Customer at subscription-creation time — Razorpay's own Create Subscription API does not accept a customer_id (confirmed against Razorpay's current API docs): the customer is captured automatically once they complete checkout authorization. This field is backfilled from the first subscription webhook whose payload includes a customer_id (Phase D), and only ever overwritten with a same-tenant value after that — never created via a separate, unlinked API call that Razorpay's own checkout would just ignore and recreate anyway.

fields.label: Timezone
fields.options:
Asia/Kolkata
Asia/Dubai
Asia/Singapore
Europe/London
America/New_York
UTC
